scripts.deploy:production: npm run build --workspace=backend && sst deploy --stage production
scripts.seed:aws: STAGE=${STAGE:-saliya} aws lambda invoke --function-name "$(aws lambda list-functions --query "Functions[?contains(FunctionName,'sezcuin-${STAGE}-Seed')].FunctionName | [0]" --output text)" --payload '{}' --cli-binary-format raw-in-base64-out /tmp/sezcuin-seed-out.json && cat /tmp/sezcuin-seed-out.json && echo
